arrival.finished.text: Craft {object} has arrived after {ticks} ticks (activity {activity} ends: 5 out of hyperspace, its order flying it from its next think; 7 out of a hangar, at its first think, its order flying it already), thinking every {interval} ticks; it follows {leader} (65535 when it leads)

arrival.formed_up.text: Craft {object} ends forming up on its flight out of a hangar after {ticks} ticks (why {why}: 0 its time ran out, 1 its flight no longer forms up, 2 an enemy is after it or a homing warhead is coming), thinking every {interval} ticks again; its order flies it from its next think

arrival.forming_up.text: Craft {object} leaves a hangar in a flight and forms up on it, following {leader} (65535 when it leads), for at most {ticks} ticks; its own think interval {interval} comes back at the end

arrival.leading.text: Craft {object} leads its flight's form-up out of a hangar on the heading it launched on, yaw {yaw} and pitch {pitch}, at throttle {throttle}, with {left} ticks left at most

arrival.started.text: Craft {object} starts arriving out of hyperspace (activity {activity}), for at most {ticks} ticks; a follower ends with its leader

attack.break.text: Craft {object} broke off from target {target}, {distance} units from its nearest part (its hull for a starship or platform), inside its clearance of {clearance}, turning to yaw {yaw} and pitch {pitch}; {blocked} is the bulky craft whose clearance turned it from the side away from the target (65535 when none did)

attack.break_end.text: Craft {object} ended its break from target {target} after {ticks} ticks ({reason}: outside, or the limit reached first), {distance} units from its nearest part (its hull for a starship or platform) against its clearance of {clearance}

attack.break_lost.text: Craft {object} ended its break after {ticks} ticks: target {target} is no longer shown

attack.evade_ordered.text: Craft {object} took up a player's evade command: it dropped its target and weaves, craft {chaser} on its tail (65535 for none)

attack.pursued.text: Craft {object} has craft {pursuer} after it, with {hull_left} of its hull strength {hull_strength} left; it fights back: {fights} (1 with cannons, able to move and three quarters of its hull or more left, or a Sith Lord at any hull)

attack.tail_trick.text: Sith craft {object} sits on the tail of starfighter {target}, {distance} units away and {angle} yaw units off its nose, and flies at a third of full throttle to turn tightest

attack.target.text: Craft {object} attacks object {target} (a craft, or a static object its order names), {distance} units from its nearest part (its hull for a starship or platform)

attack.unguided.text: Craft {object} fired an unguided warhead of type {type} from launcher {launcher} (both slots at once: {paired}) at craft {target}, aimed ahead to meet it in {ticks} ticks with its nose line {miss} units from the meeting point, its lock at {lock} ticks; {shots} fired in this attack run

attack.warhead.text: Craft {object} fired a guided warhead of type {type} from launcher {launcher} (both slots at once: {paired}) at craft {target}, its lock at {lock} ticks, {coming} homing warheads already flying at the target; {shots} fired in this attack run

attack.warhead_held.text: Craft {object} holds its warheads at craft {target} ({reason}: the first test that failed of kind, kept, launcher, lock, fresh, limit, caps and aim), its lock at {lock} ticks in state {lock_state}, {coming} homing warheads with {coming_damage} damage already flying at the target; {shots} fired in this attack run

attack.warhead_unmade.text: Craft {object} asked launcher {launcher} for a warhead at craft {target} and the engine made none (its launcher wait is not running, so the craft counts no shot and may ask again)

avoidance.level.text: Craft {object}, over or under the hull of craft {around}, {distance} units from its nearest part, with a clearance of {clearance} from there, finds every yaw in the way and pitches to {pitch}, past the clearance's edge on the level side, to fly level across the hull until past its edge

avoidance.steer.text: Craft {object} steered clear of craft {around}, {distance} units from its nearest part (its hull for a starship or platform), with a clearance of {clearance} from there, to yaw {yaw}; searched {searched} (1 when the way past the nearest was not free and it searched the headings its nose could reach)

avoidance.way_in.text: Craft {object}, steering dead on its drop point inside the clearance of craft {around}, finds the point {off} units off that craft's body (its box for a starship or platform, else the ball of three quarters of its size) and the straight line there {least} units off it at its nearest; clear {clear} (1 when the line keeps the craft's reach off the body, or the point's own distance where that is less, so the craft may fly in)

board.approach.text: Craft {object} on a boarding order closes on craft {target}: {left} units left, throttle {throttle}, measured to its board point {pointed} (else to its clearance), at the point {there}

board.at_point.text: Craft {object} on a boarding order waits at its board point beside craft {target} for the dock

board.dock.text: Craft {object} on order {order} asks the engine to dock it with craft {target}, at its board point

board.docking.text: Craft {object} is docked by the engine with craft {target}, phase {phase} (1 align, 2 transfer, 3 separate), and sends no target, steer or throttle

board.looking.text: Craft {object} on order {order} stops to look for a craft to board: its order names {named} craft, {boardable} of them boardable now

board.lost.text: Craft {object} on a boarding order gives up craft {target} ({why}: gone from the battle, its slot replaced, wrecked, or taken by another boarder) and looks again

board.target.text: Craft {object} on order {order} picks craft {target} to board ({source}: a player's command, or the nearest of {boardable} boardable of the {named} its order names), {distance} units away by the rough distance

board.undocked.text: The engine's dock of craft {object} with craft {target} has ended: boarded {boarded} (1 when the craft boarded it and looks again where it is, 0 when the engine gave the dock up and it keeps its target)

captured.still.text: Captured craft {object} holds still for good, as it cannot fly home: full speed {full_speed}, its systems off {disabled}

countermeasures.incoming.text: Homing shot {threat} (object type {type}) is {distance} units from craft {object}, inside its swerve range of {range}: the first such shot aimed at it, the one a weaving behavior weaves from

countermeasures.threat.text: Craft {object} weighs homing shot {threat} (object type {type}), {distance} units away inside its range of {range}, the first such shot aimed at it; its countermeasure type is {kind} (1 chaff, 2 flare) and it launches one: {launch} (0 when a countermeasure already homes on that shot)

disable.targets.text: Craft {object} on a Disable order has {named} targets its order names, {working} of them with subsystems that work; once a player's commands apply it fights the nearest of {chosen}, with its {ion_groups} ion cannon groups alone (none fire when it has none)

dropoff.approach.text: Craft {object} on Drop Off flies to its drop point for group {group} (the order's variable2, counted from 1): {left} units left, throttle {throttle}

dropoff.at_point.text: Craft {object} on Drop Off stops at its drop point and asks the engine to drop group {group} (the order's variable2, counted from 1)

dropoff.done.text: Craft {object} on Drop Off is done with group {group} (the order's variable2, counted from 1): {delivered} delivered, or nothing to deliver

dropoff.drop.text: Craft {object} on Drop Off waits while the engine drops: phase {phase} (1 the push to a place, 2 the wait after a delivery), {delivered} delivered

dropoff.dropping.text: The engine drops group {group} (the order's variable2, counted from 1) from craft {object}

dropoff.no_leader.text: Craft {object} on Drop Off follows craft {leader}, which it cannot follow now (not shown, flown by a player, leaving, or no place given), and holds still

dropoff.no_point.text: Craft {object} on Drop Off for group {group} (the order's variable2, counted from 1) has no drop point and is not done (books {books}), and holds still

dropoff.stopped.text: Craft {object} stops its drop to go home (books {books}): {delivered} delivered

escort.station.text: Craft {object} on an Escort order keeps station {distance} units from craft {escorted}, the craft it escorts: beyond {range}, or with that craft disabled ({disabled}), it flies at it, else to its station

escort.threats.text: Craft {object} on an Escort order escorts craft {escorted} (65535 for none), whose flight group shows {group} craft; {threats} enemies in reach target one of them

formation.far.text: Craft {object} is {distance} units from its place beside leader {leader}, past the far reach and not behind it: it flies straight at the place at full throttle

formation.fly.text: Craft {object} flies to its place beside leader {leader}: the place lies {ahead} units ahead along the leader's heading (behind when negative) and {aside} units aside; it asks speed {speed}, throttle {throttle}

home.after_leader.text: Craft {object} departs after its leader {leader}, which has begun its jump and flies at speed {speed}: sure {sure} (1 when that speed reached the last call, 0 on the craft's own roll)

home.route.text: Craft {object} goes home by route {route} (jump, hangar, enter, wait or stop; fight, turned on the craft after it; evade, home weaving from it; stranded, no way out, fighting any enemy) from activity {from}, with books bits {books}

kamikaze.closing.text: Craft {object} on a Kamikaze order dives at craft {target}, {distance} units away, {off_nose} yaw units off its nose and {off_level} pitch units off level; lined up for its cannons: {lined_up}; its warheads held for {held} (none when it fires one); {shots} fired in this dive

kamikaze.cruise.text: Craft {object} on a Kamikaze order cruises its waypoints, making for waypoint {waypoint}: {targets} targets it may dive at, a weave under way: {weaving} (it dives once the weave ends)

kamikaze.dive.text: Craft {object} on a Kamikaze order begins a dive at craft {target} (genus {genus}), {distance} units away, the nearest of {targets} targets or the one a player's command named

kamikaze.evade_ordered.text: Craft {object} on a Kamikaze order took up a player's evade command: it dropped its target and weaves, craft {chaser} on its tail (65535 for none)

kamikaze.warhead.text: Craft {object} on a Kamikaze order fired a guided warhead of type {type} from launcher {launcher} at craft {target}, its lock at {lock} ticks, {coming} homing warheads already flying at the target; {shots} fired in this dive

kamikaze.warhead_unmade.text: Craft {object} on a Kamikaze order asked launcher {launcher} for a warhead at craft {target} and the engine made none (its launcher wait is not running, so the craft counts no shot and may ask again)

lord.lead.text: Craft {object}, a Sith Lord, aims at craft {target}'s meeting point ({x}, {y}, {z}), its shot there in {ticks} ticks (the target's own position and 0 out of reach); {tracers} of its tracers passed the target since its last look, missing it on average by {miss_ahead} ahead, {miss_side} to its right and {miss_up} above, in the target's axes; its correction is now {fix_ahead}, {fix_side}, {fix_up}; it fires: {fire}

lord.stays.text: Craft {object}, a Sith Lord, stays in the battle with its group's abort trigger held (books {books}): it never retreats, and only its departure time or its orders done send it home

notebook.unreadable.text: Craft {object}'s notebook could not be read ({error}); behavior {behavior} starts it again

order.no_behavior.text: No behavior flies order code {code}, the order of craft {object}; it drifts

patrol.hold.text: Craft {object} has no waypoint on and stops where it is; rounds flown on this order: {rounds}

patrol.reached.text: Craft {object} reached waypoint {waypoint} and makes for waypoint {next} (the same one when it is its only waypoint); rounds flown on this order: {rounds}

program.crashed.text: The AI program failed with {error_type} at {where}: {error}; it stops with exit code 1

program.refused.text: A question broke the message format and was not answered ({error}); the AI program stops with exit code 2

program.started.text: The AI program started as process {pid}, reading messages of wire version {wire}

program.stopped.text: Standard input ended after {questions} questions; the AI program stops with exit code 0

progress.move.text: Craft {object} moves from order slot {from} to slot {to}, the slot it left taking completion state {state} ({why}: next, skip, done or home)

protect.attackers.text: Craft {object} on a Protect order has {named} craft its order names, {hit} of them hit by a craft of some team, and {attackers} enemies attacking those: each that targets one, or whose shot hit one last

rendezvous.fly.text: Craft {object} on Rendezvous flies to its rendezvous point: {left} units left, throttle {throttle}

rendezvous.no_point.text: Craft {object} on Rendezvous has no rendezvous point named (books {books}) and holds still

rendezvous.waiting.text: Craft {object} on Rendezvous stops {left} units from its rendezvous point to wait for boarding craft: {boarded} boardings counted of {needed}

seek.no_point.text: Craft {object} has no target, no waypoint on and no start point given, and holds its course

seek.start_point.text: Craft {object} has no target and no waypoint on, and makes for its group's start point, {distance} away, at throttle {throttle} (0: a starship or freighter stopped there, or a starship turning)

think.answer.text: Craft {object} is answered with action bits {actions}: turn to heading {yaw}, pitch {pitch} and roll {roll}, throttle {throttle}, activity {activity}, think every {interval} ticks (0 where not sent); target {target} (65535 where not sent); cannon group 0 link mode {mode_first} burst {burst_first}, group 1 mode {mode_second} burst {burst_second}; fire launcher {launcher} (-1 for none), paired {paired}; aim {turrets} turrets; arrival {arriving} at speed {speed} (0 and 0 where not sent); order slot {order_slot}, the slot left taking state {order_state} (-1 and 0 where not sent); notebook {notebook}

think.contact.text: Contact {object} (signature {signature}, type {type}, genus {genus}, team {team}, flight group {group}, object kind {kind}, flags {flags}) is at ({x}, {y}, {z}) heading {yaw} pitch {pitch}, speed {speed}, targeting {target}, last hit by {attacker} (65535 for none); shields front {front} rear {rear}, hull damage {hull_damage} of {hull}; activity {activity}; size {size}, last shot by {hit_by} (65535 for none); model box from ({min_x}, {min_y}, {min_z}) to ({max_x}, {max_y}, {max_z}) in the model's own axes (all 0 for none), roll {roll}, boarded by {boarder} (65535 for none), weapon fire inhibited for {weapon_inhibit_timer} more ticks, {pulses_coming} homing pulses coming at it; turned {yaw_turned} in yaw and {pitch_turned} in pitch (65,536ths of a turn, signed) and changed speed by {speed_changed} over {turn_ticks} ticks (0 at first sight)

think.question.text: The question for tick {tick} asks about {craft} craft and shows {contacts} contacts and {statics} statics, flying mission file version {mission_version}

think.threat.text: Homing shot {threat} (object type {type}) is aimed at craft {object} from ({x}, {y}, {z}); a countermeasure homes on it: {decoyed}

think.turret.text: Craft {object} aims the turret in weapon slot {slot} at object {target} (65535 for none), ion {ion} (1 fires ion shots)

think.view.text: Craft {object} (signature {signature}, type {type}, flight group {group}, team {team}, skill {skill}) on order {order} in slot {slot}, activity {activity}, thinking every {interval} ticks, is at ({x}, {y}, {z}) heading {yaw} pitch {pitch} roll {roll}, speed {speed}, throttle {throttle}, random seed {seed}; order target mask {targets}, turret slot mask {turrets}; {cannons} cannon groups firing types {cannon_first} and {cannon_second}; {launchers} launchers holding types {warhead_first} and {warhead_second}, {left_first} and {left_second} left, ready in {cooldown_first} and {cooldown_second} ticks; enemy mask {enemies}, leader {leader} (65535 when it leads); order codes {codes} and completion states {states} by slot, order throttle {order_throttle}, variables {variable_first} and {variable_second}, order speed {order_speed}; full speed {full_speed}; books bits {books}; mothership {mothership} (65535 for none) with its outside hangar point ({outside_x}, {outside_y}, {outside_z}) and inside one ({inside_x}, {inside_y}, {inside_z}); home point ({home_x}, {home_y}, {home_z}); countermeasure {countermeasure} (0 none, 1 chaff, 2 flare), {countermeasures_left} left, system working {countermeasure_working}, chaff running for {chaff_seconds} more simulated seconds, {countermeasure_cooldown} ticks before another launches; {threats} homing shots aimed at it, each on a think.threat line; waypoint mask {waypoints} (bit n set when mission point 4 + n is on), each point on a think.waypoint line; commands bits {commands} (1 wait, 2 evade), the target a player's attack or cover order gave it {command_target} and the one an ignore order told it to leave alone {avoid_target} (65535 for none); its formation place ({place_x}, {place_y}, {place_z}), 0 when it has none; maneuver timer {timer} ticks; escorting craft {escorted} (65535 for none) with its station at ({station_x}, {station_y}, {station_z}); its group's start point ({start_x}, {start_y}, {start_z}), 0 before it has arrived; orders with a target now, by slot bits {targets_now}; static target mask {static_targets}; board point ({board_x}, {board_y}, {board_z}), 0 when it has none; boardings done by slot {progress}; signatures of the craft it has boarded {boarded}; the engine's dock of it at phase {board_phase} (0 none, 1 align, 2 transfer, 3 separate); lifetime timer {lifetime_timer} ticks (0 when none runs); contacts that match the first pair of its order's targets alone, mask {first_pair}; drop point ({drop_x}, {drop_y}, {drop_z}), 0 when it has none; the engine's drop of it at phase {drop_phase} (0 none, 1 push to the place, 2 wait after a delivery); rendezvous point ({rendezvous_x}, {rendezvous_y}, {rendezvous_z}), 0 when it has none; notebook {notebook}

think.waypoint.text: The group of craft {object} has waypoint {waypoint} (mission point 4 + {waypoint}) on, at ({x}, {y}, {z})

selfdestruct.start.text: Craft {object} stops for its Self Destruct order in slot {slot} and asks for a countdown of {units} units, {ticks} ticks (its order asks for {ordered}, and 0 for 2 to 5 at random)

selfdestruct.too_long.text: Craft {object} stops for its Self Destruct order in slot {slot} but never asks for a countdown: {units} units is more than the engine's timer holds

wait.end.text: Craft {object} was released from a player's wait command and flies its order again

wait.start.text: Craft {object} stops and waits, as a player's wait command told it

waiting.start.text: Craft {object} stops for its Wait order in slot {slot} and sets its timer to {ticks} ticks

warheads.disable_limit.text: Craft {object} disabling craft {target} counts its front shield, with a tenth of its hull once more than a tenth is damaged, as {durability}; the warheads flying at it and one from each of its launchers that may go at it ({salvo} of that) come to {coming} once divided; it fires only while the shield lasts ({lasts})

warheads.lead.text: Craft {object} with no lock on craft {target} finds that a warhead from launcher {launcher} fired now unguided meets it at ({dx}, {dy}, {dz}) from the craft in {ticks} ticks, of a life of {life}, its nose line passing {miss} units from that point; the shot goes ({aimed}) when that is under half the target's size, {half}, within the life

weave.end.text: Craft {object} ended its weave after {swerves} swerves ({reason}: the tail clear, or the limit reached with the chaser still there); no weave starts before tick {rest_until}

weave.start.text: Craft {object} began to weave away from craft {threat} on its tail, about course {course}, first swerving to side {side} (0 the lower yaw, 1 the higher) at pitch {pitch} until tick {ends}

weave.swerve.text: Craft {object} began swerve {swerve} of its weave, to side {side} at pitch {pitch} until tick {ends}; flare dropped {flare}
